race.comment: ESTADIO MESTALLA (1) has improved at each run this prep. Turned in a real eye-catcher in the 1400m Group 3 Alan Brown last start, thundering home from a long way back to be beaten a long neck. Rock hard fit and screaming out for the mile now. Big chance despite the 61kgs. ANYTHINK GOES (10) missed by a lip in the 2100m Wyong Cup two back then found 1400m too sharp last time. Veteran who loves this trip and is in with a chance at the weights. ANTHRACITE (9) led all the way and just prevailed over an in-form Barrengarry a fortnight ago over 2000m at Rosehill. Coming back to the Randwick mile is of no concern. Genuine contender down on 52kgs. LORD PENMAN (5) failed first-up at Caulfield. Draws the fence and is capable of a lot better. THRICE (11) returns from a five-month spell and has been gelded. Better known over more ground than this but a mile while fresh with no weight looks a nice set-up.
